instruction.text: Match the words with their definitions.
Is the word in bold an adjective or an adverb?

atoms.a: Mountain climbing can be a dangerous sport.
My mum is often tired because she works really hard.

wrong.text: The word hard is both an adjective and an adverb. However, in this sentence it is describing the verb, so it is an adverb.
